title: Route difficult documentation to resumable parsers
objective: Existing document parsers cover known document families with explicit residual queues.
outcome: A parser is selected by validated format/layout evidence; unsupported/scanned documents remain residual tasks. Restart mid-document shows no lost or duplicate fields; changed source bytes invalidate incompatible checkpoints. The coverage report accounts for parser defect, missing source, encrypted/scanned content and ambiguous layout without live source traffic.

commits.subject: Build a parser capability registry
commits.instructions: Map captured document signatures/layout families to existing CSV, XLSX, text-PDF and grid parsers. Use exact version/hash inputs and known CMS cause-ledger fixtures.
commits.verification: A parser is selected by validated format/layout evidence; unsupported/scanned documents remain residual tasks.

commits.subject: Connect bounded page-window resume
commits.instructions: Reuse existing PDF window capture and parser checkpoints. Record page/table/row positions and parser-specific defects; cap OCR work separately if enabled.
commits.verification: Restart mid-document and show no lost or duplicate fields; changed source bytes invalidate incompatible checkpoints.

commits.subject: Emit a document extraction coverage report
commits.instructions: Reprocess retained CMS/CDC/Census documents without source traffic. Group failures by parser defect, missing source, encrypted/scanned content or ambiguous layout.
commits.verification: The report accounts for those groups and does not convert residual work into payload success.
